csv_project_name: Consultant Scv Bridge Maintenance Status & Priority Study
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Modesto (City) is soliciting Request for Proposals (RFP) from qualified bridge consultants for the Bridge Maintenance Status and Priority Study Project All-Inclusive Consulting Services for the City of Modesto. The purpose of the project is to establish a contract with a professional consultant for civil engineering services. The scope of services will consist of, but not limited to, preparing maintenance status reports and providing priority studies as determined based on initial tasks, the engineering design and preparation of plans, specifications and estimates for bridge maintenance project. The scope of services will also include, but not limited to, reviewing bridge inspection reports, conducting additional bridge inspections, providing bridge priority maintenance reports, design services, cost estimates, conducting necessary environmental studies, clearing NEPA and CEQA environmental requirements, obtaining State and Federal Permits and authorizations, securing any other relevant permits per Standard Environmental Standards (SER). Scope of Services shall also include obtaining all required right-of-way and easements, coordination with all relevant utility agencies, surveying, project management, and public outreach services if needed.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning
